groups.check: url/An absolute http or https URL answers every member as RN's regular expressions do
url/A bare host gets the slash RN's constructor writes, unless a query follows
url/Other schemes and bare paths keep their text and answer only what RN's patterns match
url/A base is joined to the URL the way RN's constructor writes it
url/The constructor throws RN's TypeError for an invalid base, and the engine's where RN does not guard
url/search is the one setter, and every other member is read-only
url/searchParams is a live instance that toString folds back into the URL
url/The class has the members RN's source writes, and no canParse or parse
url/createObjectURL builds its URL from the blob module's constants
searchParams/A string is split, decoded and appended as RN's constructor does
searchParams/null, nothing and a number make an empty list
searchParams/An object and an array of pairs are appended in order
searchParams/RN does not iterate a Map or an iterator, and reads another instance as an object
searchParams/append, get, getAll, has, set and delete behave as RN's class does
searchParams/keys, values, entries, forEach and the iterator walk the entries in order
searchParams/sort orders the keys with localeCompare and keeps the order of equal keys
searchParams/toString encodes spaces as plus signs and the rest with encodeURIComponent
searchParams/The class has the members RN's source writes, a size and no toJSON
abort/A new controller has an open signal of RN's classes
abort/abort() without a reason aborts with an AbortError once, and a second abort does nothing
abort/abort(reason) keeps any reason the caller gives, the falsy ones included
abort/Listeners and onabort run in the order they were added, and a replaced onabort keeps its place
abort/Listener options, removal and a listener added during the dispatch behave as RN's EventTarget does
abort/throwIfAborted throws the reason itself
abort/AbortSignal.abort and AbortSignal.any make signals that are already or soon aborted
abort/AbortSignal.timeout rejects a bad time with RN's TypeError
abort/AbortSignal cannot be constructed, and the members refuse another object
abort/AbortSignal.timeout aborts with a TimeoutError, alone and inside any
encoding/TextEncoder encodes ASCII, BMP, astral characters, lone surrogates and the boundaries to the UTF-8 bytes Node's encoders give
encoding/TextEncoder has the shape of the engine's class, and its result is a Uint8Array
encoding/encode turns its argument into a string first, so an absent one is the text undefined (Node's gives no bytes)
encoding/encodeInto fills the destination and reports what it read and wrote as Node's does
encoding/encodeInto refuses what is not a Uint8Array with a TypeError
encoding/btoa writes the base64 of a Latin-1 string as Node's does
encoding/atob reads base64, skips ASCII whitespace and discards trailing bits as Node's does
encoding/btoa and atob round-trip every byte, a long string and UTF-8 text
encoding/Invalid base64 input throws an Error where Node's throws an InvalidCharacterError
encoding/btoa and atob without an argument coerce undefined to text, where Node's throw a TypeError
decoder/typeof TextDecoder is undefined, it is not a property of the global object, and the negative fixture sees no descriptor
decoder/Reading or constructing TextDecoder throws the engine's ReferenceError
decoder/TextEncoder, atob and btoa are functions beside the absent decoder
